title: She Paid For 5 Years And Owed More Than She Borrowed #shorts #islamicfinance
description:
Case file: $30,000 borrowed. Sixty payments made. $9,000 gone — and a balance of $31,790. Nothing had gone wrong. The interest billed $175 a month, her payment was $150, and every month the $25 difference was added back to what she owed. She was never repaying a loan. She was renting money. Qard hasan is the contract where a loan earns nothing, ever: borrow 30,000, repay 30,000.

Part 15 of The Money Machine, Decoded.
